result.reason: The episode provides another correct cross-unit trial of the existing Task Evaluate dual-verdict Candidate and a concrete infrastructure lesson, but neither requires a new Candidate. Scoped activation still requires the separate deterministic protected-baseline gate, and one timing run is insufficient for a duration-aware sharding Candidate.
retained_learning: For infrastructure changes, exact job conclusions, dependency topology, exhaustive assignment, unchanged-head integration, and main readback form a stronger evidence chain than test counts alone.
A conservative whole-gate timing comparison can justify a reversible CI adoption while retaining load, variance, and imbalance caveats.
Modulo node-ID sharding was deterministic and exhaustive but materially imbalanced; collect repeat-run data before adding scheduling complexity.
Faster CI reduces internal feedback latency but is not capability or AGI evidence.
Original-goal FAIL plus bounded-unit PASS should continue through Consolidate Episode and Learn back to Root without voluntary termination.
